response.sql: WITH store_counts AS (SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM store AS s LEFT JOIN customer AS c ON c.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.store_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers, COUNT(*) AS store_count FROM store_counts) SELECT sc.store_id, sc.customer_count, sc.customer_count / NULLIF(t.total_customers, 0) AS share_of_customers, sc.customer_count / NULLIF(t.total_customers / t.store_count, 0) AS multiple_of_average FROM store_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN totals AS t ORDER BY sc.store_id
